latestVersion.changelog:
Video Editor Transitions 1.0.0 — Initial release.

- Instantly add smooth transitions between video clips via a cloud-based editor.
- Accepts MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads (up to 500MB) and outputs 1080p MP4.
- No installation or complex controls; simply upload clips and describe your desired transitions.
- Automatic session setup, credit management, and export workflow.
- Built for YouTubers and fast-moving content creators seeking polished edits without manual timeline work.
